name: Jean
source:
The young leader of Mersin's Royal Guard.
He is involved in a romantic and sexual relationship with Princess Salthe, to whom he promises a future together.
His serious, disciplined and hard-working personality is admired by his subordinates.
He is also Mersin's best swordsman.
